# Product scope

- Start from `README.md` defensive scope and Beta criteria.
- Choose one authorized telemetry dataset and one defensive decision to support.
- Define labels metrics false-positive tolerance and evaluation split before implementation.
- State threat model data source and unsupported attack classes.
- Exclude offensive exploitation payload generation and evasion features.
- Require reproducible evaluation tests and documented limitations before completion.
